memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day. - Gen 1:23 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Another day of God's work draws to a close, marked by the same gentle words we have come to know so well: "there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day." The seas now teem with fish, the skies are alive with birds, and God has blessed them to flourish. Five days of good, faithful work are complete.

By now this refrain has become like a familiar heartbeat running through the creation story. Evening and morning. Evening and morning. Steady, unhurried, faithful. God is showing us that He works in rhythm and order, never in panic, never in confusion. Each day is finished before the next begins.

There is rest for our souls in this. We live in a restless world, always chasing the next thing, rarely pausing to see what God has already done. But this quiet refrain invites us to stop and notice, another day complete, another portion of God's good work finished.

Perhaps you can borrow this rhythm for your own life. At the close of each day, pause and remember God's faithfulness through it. Even hard days end under His care, and morning comes again by His mercy (Lam 3:22-23).

The God who faithfully completed the fifth day is the same God watching over your evenings and mornings now. Nothing He begins is left undone, and every day rests in His faithful hands.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you take time at the end of your day to notice God's faithfulness in it?
2. How might the rhythm of evening and morning bring more rest to your soul?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for Your faithfulness through every evening and morning. Help me pause to notice Your goodness and rest in Your steady care each day. Amen.
